messages:
maya: Morning—quick async rundown for SDKs/sampleapps/docs.
maya: What I did: landed the Node quickstart edits (typo fixes + clearer auth section), updated sampleapp README to show env var examples.
maya: Blockers: flakey macOS CI on the sampleapp; failing tests only on M1 runners, need someone to look at build matrix.
maya: Today: patch the mac wheels step and open a follow-up PR for the README screenshots.

trent: thanks — I can take the macOS CI flake in an hour. saw the failure: brew part times out on some runners.
trent: quick note: in the sampleapp Dockerfile we still use node:16; should we bump to 18? that may fix some deps.

chris: fwiw bumped to node:18 in a branch earlier, but a transitive dep regressed. I'll try a patch that pins the failing dep and re-run CI.
chris: also pinged infra for extra M1 quota to repro locally :wave:

viv: docs-bot flagged one outdated snippet in the Python quickstart (auth example uses old client constructor).
viv: I can open a tiny PR to replace `RedwoodClient(api_key=...)` with the new `Client.from_env()` pattern.

maya: awesome, viv — please include a one-line note about token rotation best-practice.
maya: Also: can we add a short troubleshooting section for the sampleapp under "Common CI issues"? two quick items: mac runners + pip resolver.

trent: on the Docker/node bump — I'll make a follow PR after chris's pin lands so we don't conflict.

chris: CI re-run in progress. snippet of the failing command:
```
brew install libomp && npm ci --no-optional
```
chris: brew is the slow part; I'm switching to prebuilt binary for libomp to speed it up.

ci-bot: build/5239991111-sampleapp-macos #failed -> requeued by chris

docs-bot: note: DOC-4327 linked to python quickstart snippet update

maya: tiny ask — can someone do a quick review of my README screenshot PR? no functional changes, just content. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/142

trent: happy to review in 15m.

viv: i'll take the python snippet PR now.

maya: blockers addressed for now — will wait on the CI fix and the two small PRs before cutting the next release bundle.

chris: progress update: pinned dep + libomp binary workaround applied, CI passing on my fork. will open PR in ~30.

maya: perfect. if anything blocks you ping me here and i can escalate to infra. :thumbsup:

maya: end of async — thanks team!
